 import { sum } from './lib/sum';
 import { Cache } from './lib/cache';

 export const cache = new Cache(128);

 export function total(xs: number[]):
 number {
   const hit = cache.get(xs.join(","));
   if (hit !== undefined) return hit;
   const value = sum(xs);
   cache.set(xs.join(","), value);
   return value;
 }
